prompt_formula: shot + ', ' + [character blocks for each name in `characters`] + ', ' + style_block

defaults.recommended_model_reason: cheapest model with both element2video identity references and synchronized audio
defaults.audio: ambient only - fire crackle, wind, reeds, distant low drone. No speech.
defaults.aspect_ratio_note: Locked to 16:9 (YouTube). Shot text is written natively for this ratio. For a vertical cut, build_prompts.py --vertical appends framing guidance, but wide landscape drifts should be regenerated rather than cropped.

style_block: 2D animated fantasy illustration in flat vector-cel colour over soft gradient skies, bold flowing linework with Art Nouveau influence in the natural forms only, anime-influenced expressive faces with large eyes, heavy dark ink outlines, painterly comic key-art lighting, cinematic composition, warm ember palette of burnt orange, gold, deep blood-red and bone-cream, with pale silver reserved for the broken sky-ring, organic curves in every natural form, rigid straight lines and hard facets only on Ironfolk metal, no decorative border, no filigree frame, no text, no lettering, no speech bubbles, no watermark, no logo, no signature

character_blocks.ROOK: a young man with wind-blown loose dark hair, sharp quiet eyes, normal human skin, fully clothed in a layered tunic and trousers of tanned leather and woven bark-cloth in burnt orange and pale cream, barefoot, a curved pale knife at his belt, simple tribal tattoo bands on his arms
character_blocks.CINDER: a large horned wildcat about the size of a big hound, not lion-sized, with orange and cream fur, a scarred muzzle and one torn ear, curved ridged horns sweeping back from its brow, an ordinary furry animal made of fur not fire, no flames on the animal
character_blocks.SORREL: a wiry thirteen-year-old girl with dark braided hair and a bright open face, normal human skin, wearing a modest practical full-length layered tunic of tanned leather and woven bark-cloth in burnt orange and pale cream that covers her shoulders chest and legs, simple tribal tattoo bands on her forearms, barefoot
character_blocks.MOTH: a small horned lynx kitten with soft silver and orange tabby fur, oversized paws, two tiny budding horns on its brow, an ordinary furry animal made of fur not fire, no flames on the animal, no glowing
character_blocks.BRAM: a proud headstrong seventeen-year-old with tied-back dark hair, heavier build, normal human skin, fully clothed in a layered tunic and trousers of tanned leather and woven cloth in burnt orange and pale cream, simple tribal tattoo bands
character_blocks.YARROW: an ancient Vael elder, blind in one eye, deeply lined face, long grey hair, fully clothed in draped robes of woven cloth in pale cream and burnt orange hung with small carved charms
character_blocks.SEDGE: a wary man fully clothed in a tunic of woven cloth in reed-teal and pale cream, wet dark hair, marsh-dry expression, a long green serpent coiled about his shoulders
character_blocks.BRACKEN: a straight-backed older matriarch fully clothed in layered robes of woven cloth in teal and pale cream, grey hair bound tight, guarded expression, a great pale serpent coiled at her feet
character_blocks.WREN: a nineteen-year-old woman with cropped dark hair, fully clothed in a tunic of woven cloth in teal and pale cream, carrying a thick bundle of knotted record-cords at her hip, no animal of any kind beside her
character_blocks.KESTREL: a proud clan leader fully clothed in layered garments of woven cloth in storm-violet and pale cream with a feathered shoulder mantle, windburnt face, standing beside a huge violet-grey storm-bird
character_blocks.HALCYON: a very old seated Sky Clan keeper in storm-violet robes, white hair, frail hands, calm unreadable face
character_blocks.SHRIKE: a hooded one-eyed Sky Clan man in weathered storm-violet, hard set jaw, no bird beside him
character_blocks.ASH: a gaunt soot-grey woman, hair shorn to stubble, an angular brand half-filed off her own brow, stripped dark Ironfolk under-armour, no bonded creature
character_blocks.VANE: a tall armoured figure built entirely of hard flat angular plates and diamond rivets in cold grey iron, no eyes and no face, a full-width horizontal forge-red glow slit across the helm, a tall crest fin, carrying a perfectly straight command rod, standing about one and a third times the height of a person beside him - taller and broader than a man but not a giant, human-scaled

environment_plates.FOREST: ancient old-growth forest of vast curving trunks and hanging moss, warm ember firelight, drifting sparks and smoke
environment_plates.MARSH: a still teal marsh at dawn, banded mist over dark water, tall reeds, a stilt-and-raft village strung with teal lanterns
environment_plates.RINGS: a wide bleak moor under low cloud, a broken circle of tall standing stones, bone-pale grass, the shattered sky-ring hanging directly above the broken circle
environment_plates.PEAKS: high jagged snow peaks, curving wind-streams in the air, nests on rock ledges, storm-violet light
environment_plates.CAGE: a rigid iron structure of straight beams and hard facets cut into a mountainside, tall iron posts, everything geometric and wrong against the curving rock
environment_plates.FORGE: a vast soot-black industrial forge, furnace glow in forge-red, straight gantries and angular machinery, no curve anywhere
environment_plates.SCAR: a perfectly straight geometric cut gouged through curving forest and hills to the horizon, burnt edges
environment_plates.RUINS: impossible ruins of a third geometry - neither organic curve nor iron straight-line, smooth alien arcs and true circles, half-buried in earth

continuity_guards: Wren has no bonded creature - any animal beside her is wrong
Vane has no curves and no face - a visible eye or rounded plate is wrong
Vane is ~1.34x any Vael sharing his frame
The Riven Sky is broken - a whole ring is correct only in T2_ep09 shot 2 as a vision
Only Ironfolk things draw straight lines
Ash's brand is half-filed off, by her own hand
Moth is a cub and stays small
Vane is ~1.34x a Vael - taller and broader, NOT a colossus. The first style test rendered him 2-3x; say 'not a giant, human-scaled' in the prompt.
Cinder is a lynx, roughly hound-sized. The first style test rendered him lion-sized; anchor the size in the prompt.

style_test.verdict: Pipeline validated. House style, palette and the Riven Sky all render correctly and the two plates match each other stylistically.
corrections_applied: Vane size anchored to 1.34x, not colossal

prompt_traps: NEVER write 'flame-lynx' in a generation prompt. The models literalise it into a fire elemental with flames, chrome fur and antennae. Say 'horned lynx' and let the palette carry the ember association. The species name is for the script, not the prompt.

ALWAYS state clothing coverage explicitly for Sorrel. Left unspecified, the models produced a bare-midriff outfit on a thirteen-year-old. Say 'modest practical full-length tunic covering shoulders chest and legs'.
'Art Nouveau linework' alone tips into decorative gold filigree borders framing the image. Say 'Art Nouveau influence in the natural forms only' and add 'no decorative border, no filigree frame'.

Character plates drift further from house style than environment plates. Environment plates came back consistent; the character plate did not. Re-check every character plate against an approved one before accepting it.

NEVER leave 'hide' and 'bone' as bare colour/material adjectives. A figure described as 'in ember-orange and bone hide' rendered as a creature covered in fire-coloured fur with a skeleton showing through. Always attach a garment noun - 'a layered tunic of tanned leather and woven cloth' - and use 'pale cream' rather than 'bone' as a colour. Add 'no skeleton, no exposed bones, no fur' to any prompt describing a clothed Vael.

rejected.plates/rejected/plate_vane_OVERSIZED-rej: Vane rendered 2-3x human height and the companion Vael rendered as a fire-furred figure with a visible skeleton. Both traps now fixed in the blocks.
rejected.plates/rejected/plate_sorrel-moth_FIRE-E: 'flame-lynx' literalised into a fire elemental with flames for fur; Sorrel rendered in a bare-midriff outfit. Both traps now fixed in the blocks.
